name: 32348 · Perry, FL
findings: ZIP 32348 (Perry) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32348 (Perry) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32348 (Perry) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
